accentObservationSummary.independentFormula: For each opaque RGB channel c/255, use c/12.92 when c <= 0.04045, otherwise ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B; ratio = (max(L1,L2)+0.05)/(min(L1,L2)+0.05).
